services.title: Web Development
services.desc: Modern, responsive, and high-performance websites and web platforms.
services.overview: We design and build modern, responsive, high-performance websites and web platforms that load fast, rank well, and convert visitors into customers. From a company's first marketing site to a complex customer portal, every build is engineered for speed, security, and scale.

process.title: Discover
process.desc: We map your goals, audience, and content to a clear site plan.

process.title: Design
process.desc: Wireframes and high-fidelity screens shaped around your brand.

process.title: Build
process.desc: Performance-first development with clean, maintainable code.

process.title: Launch & grow
process.desc: Deployment, analytics, and ongoing optimisation after go-live.

whyUs.title: Performance-first
whyUs.desc: Every build is optimised for speed, Core Web Vitals, and SEO from day one.

whyUs.title: Built to scale
whyUs.desc: Architecture that grows from first visitor to high-traffic production.

whyUs.title: Design that converts
whyUs.desc: Clean, brand-led interfaces focused on turning visitors into enquiries.

faq.q: How long does a website take to build?
faq.a: A marketing site typically takes 2-4 weeks; a custom web platform 6-12 weeks depending on scope and integrations.

faq.q: Will my website work on mobile?
faq.a: Yes. Every site we build is fully responsive and tested across phones, tablets, and desktops.

faq.q: Do you provide hosting and maintenance?
faq.a: Yes. We can deploy, host, and maintain your site, or hand over a self-hosting package with full documentation.

services.title: Mobile App Development
services.desc: Feature-rich mobile applications for Android and iOS using modern mobile technologies.
services.overview: We build feature-rich mobile applications for Android and iOS that feel native and perform flawlessly. Using Flutter and React Native, we ship one codebase to both stores — faster to market and easier to maintain.

process.title: Discover
process.desc: We define features, user flows, and the minimum lovable product.

process.title: Design
process.desc: Native-feel screens and prototypes tested with real users.

process.title: Build
process.desc: Iterative development with regular builds you can install.

process.title: Launch & grow
process.desc: Store submission, monitoring, and version updates.

whyUs.title: One codebase, both stores
whyUs.desc: Flutter and React Native cut cost and time without compromising quality.

whyUs.title: Native performance
whyUs.desc: Smooth, responsive apps that users can't tell from fully native.

whyUs.title: End-to-end delivery
whyUs.desc: From design to store submission, we handle the whole journey.

faq.q: Should I build native or cross-platform?
faq.a: For most products, cross-platform (Flutter/React Native) gives native feel at lower cost. We'll recommend the right fit for your needs.

faq.q: How much does a mobile app cost?
faq.a: It depends on features and integrations. We scope a minimum viable product first so you launch lean and iterate.

faq.q: Do you handle app store approval?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare store listings, screenshots, and manage the submission and review process for both stores.

faq.a: Yes. We build for solo founders through to large sales teams with roles, territories, and permissions.

faq.q: Is SEO a one-time thing?
